Building or operating an enterprise identity provider
baseline_note: Dirty completed-feature worktree after CRM-001, CRM-023, CRM-002, CRM-003, and CRM-004. Preserve every existing change, PROJECT_STATUS.html, official vendored assets/licenses, and the staged deletion of src/simple_crm/__pycache__/__init__.cpython-312.pyc. CRM-005 may add identity and authorization infrastructure only.
architecture_decision: The existing Django auth user remains the account boundary. The identity app owns enabled profiles, six seeded business roles, action permissions, teams, explicit object/team/campaign grants, temporary elevations, and the centralized policy service. OIDC authorization-code with PKCE is the preferred authentication path; local Argon2 login is an explicitly disabled-by-default fallback. All business visibility callers use the policy service rather than duplicating scope logic.
offboarding_policy: Disabling an identity immediately sets the profile disabled_at marker and user.is_active false. The authentication backend rejects new authentication and middleware logs out any existing session on its next request. OIDC callbacks for the disabled subject are rejected.
